title: How every Hotspawn CS2 match gets a pick when the featured market does not cover it

steps: Polymarket CS2 directory + paginated tag-slug API (up to 2000 events) → exact normalized team names + start within 60s → unique active full-series match-winner market → both CLOB order books (token/condition/size, noncrossed, spread ≤0.12) → midpoint normalized. Source: https://polymarket.com/esports/cs2, https://docs.polymarket.com/api-reference/market-data/get-order-book
If no market: HLTV research (split-anchor cards, sibling time/team, saved hash-checked HTML) → only for identity, fan votes never probability. Source: https://www.hltv.org/matches

Then Thunderpick original esportsbook POST /api/matches {gameIds:[6]} → exact fixture + prematch two-way series winner, decimal odds → p = (1/o)/Σ(1/o) with margin removal. Source: https://thunderpick.io/api/matches

Else Valve global standings snapshot ≤35d old, unique exact-name 5-player row → Glicko expectation with RD 75 via Valve model/fit.js. Uncalibrated research estimate. Source: https://github.com/ValveSoftware/counter-strike_regional_standings/blob/main/model/fit.js
featured_method.result_on_2026_10_15: 80 records, 17 upcoming, 13 picks (7 market,1 bookmaker,5 model), 4 unresolved

originated_complete_list.policy: Only for fixtures the featured method leaves unresolved or with a model-only estimate: re-try with verified-alias-joined names, then consensus. Money lines never overwrite featured money lines; they replace only featured models (upgraded_from_featured_model).
steps: Verified-alias Polymarket series-winner books (alias via registry, e.g., WBT→WROTBERRY with HLTV team page 13683 + event 9332 + Liquipedia evidence). Spread ≤0.12, same freshness/start checks.

Verified-alias esportsbook paired prices (Thunderpick, Bovada public prematch moneylines, Pinnacle guest board period 0) — one vote each, median consensus. Thunderpick is primary low-tier source (low-tier Elisa fixtures rarely on Polymarket).
Median consensus across independent money families (Polymarket,Kalshi,Thunderpick,Bovada,Pinnacle) — majority vote, not average.

Reviewed aggregated bookmaker average (EGamersWorld dated sentence, hash-checked) — only when all first-party ladders fail, never overriding first-party price. Rejected if identical 1.80/1.80 placeholder or contradictory.
Valve-rating and HLTV-ranking research-model fallbacks (uncalibrated, labeled), or wide-book guidance (wide spread midpoint, guidance only).
originated_complete_list.alias_registry: data/origination/aliases.json — 6 entries (WBT→WROTBERRY, ROUNDS→RoundsGG, HAVU Gaming→HAVU, EA Copenhagen→EAC, Esport Academy Copenhagen→EAC, Phantom Esports→Phantom), each with HLTV/Liquipedia evidence links. No fuzzy joins.
originated_complete_list.result_on_2026_10_15: 17/17 resolved: 7 market, 5 bookmaker (4 alias-joined Thunderpick: WBT/ENCE 1.50/2.40→61.5%, WBT/BOJONG 1.20/4.00→76.9%, HAVU/RoundsGG 1.20/4.00→76.9%, RoundsGG/Voca 5.80/1.10→84.1% Voca), 5 model. 0 unresolved. All probabilities sum to 1.0, all rows link official source.

hltv_first_then_esportsbook: HLTV is tried before books because low-tier matches have no betting market at scheduled time; HLTV confirms fixture identity and independently published BO format (without filling Hotspawn's unknown best_of). Books are only read after HLTV identity is confirmed or ruled out. No book line is invented when HLTV has no row; the Valve model is next.
unresolved_section: Executive summary (#unresolved), complete list (origination/#unresolved), featured feed (picks/#unresolved) and review page (review/#unresolved) all present. Empty state explicitly says '0 unresolved' or lists blanks with blocker ('no external line', 'no rating', 'book too wide', etc.). Coverage probe dossier (data/research/8fa2b226/coverage-probe.json) lists every blank one-by-one with provider observations, never writing a probability.
betting_line_sources_tried_per_fixture: GG.BET / Rivalry / Stake reachability checks (403/redirect → unavailable, not 'no market')
limitations_published: HLTV/Bookmaker 403/redirect, differing provider names (only alias-joined), uncalibrated models, past-start archive, unverified best-of, wide-book guidance. Every limitation carries source URL and observation time.
verification: Every probability in origination.json replayed from saved original responses (scripts/validate.py, scripts/build.py). Row-source audit: 515 rows, 501 official-linked, 5 flagged, 9 nav, 0 violations. No pick invented without a two-sided observed price or a published rating row.
